name: smart-family-budget-planning-system
description: Smart Family Budget Planning System - full-stack family finance platform (React + Express + PostgreSQL + Prisma)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:migrate --prefix backend && npm run seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
